content: As for $LPK: Maybe $3B-$5B seems reasonable when they fully volume ramp if I had to guess. Feels more asymmetrical to me personally since it's just a waiting game and they have the customers for glass substrates. Small machine supplier chokepoints usually cap out from TAM though and don't go to $20B+ unless you're ASML or hold many chokepoints like KLAC. Not many dominant "monopolies" like these out there right before volume ramp this small: Maybe you have stuff like: - Aixtron (MOCVD) ~$8B - Towa (compression bonding) ~$2B - Techwing (memory handler/cube probes) ~$1.5B - MSScorps (CPO inspection), but pre-ramp. $850M - Riber (quantum MBE), very pre-ramp ~$350M Then LPK Laser for glass core substrates (about to ramp) at ~$730M, which thematically should have more premiums than memory. (eg. major advanced packaging shift, CPO adjacent, etc). Lot of obscure chemical monopolies I know of, but those don't get as much attention cause BOM is much lower than equipment. But for lpk you have: eg. “80% of customers among major global players have selected LPKF equipment”. 70% of LIDE market share target for TGV in the glass-core ramp, should be very material. (disclosure: own, the listed names above aside from techwing/aixtron, NFI). Just kinda the path they go if you follow $AEHR at ~$3.5B now: - <$500m: "Oh they have no customers!" ---> (probably somewhere in the middle here). - < $1.5B: "Maybe volume comes soon!" - $3B+ onward: "Looks like they're starting to volume ramp. Just a lesson for the cycle of the chokepoint machine suppliers from my personal experiences.
translated: 至于 $LPK：如果我不得不猜测的话，当它们完全成交量上升时，也许 $3B-$5B 似乎是合理的。我个人感觉更不对称，因为这只是一场等待游戏，而且他们有玻璃基板的客户。小型机器供应商的瓶颈通常会受到 TAM 的限制，并且不会达到 $20B+，除非您是 ASML 或拥有许多像 KLAC 这样的瓶颈。在产量如此之小之前，没有多少像这样的主导“垄断”：也许你有这样的东西： - Aixtron (MOCVD) ~$8B - Towa (压缩粘合) ~$2B - Techwing (内存处理器/立方体探针) ~$1.5B - MSScorps (CPO 检查)，但预斜坡。 8.5 亿美元 - Riber（量子 MBE），非常预爬升 ~ 3.5 亿美元，然后用于玻璃芯基板的 LPK 激光（即将爬升）约为 7.3 亿美元，从主题上讲，其溢价应该比内存更高。 （例如，主要先进封装转移、CPO 相邻等）。我知道有很多不起眼的化学垄断企业，但这些企业并没有受到太多关注，因为 BOM 远低于设备。但对于 lpk 你有：例如。 “全球主要企业中80%的客户都选择了LPKF设备”。 LIDE 玻璃芯坡道 TGV 市场份额的 70% 目标应该是非常重要的。 （披露：拥有，上面列出的名称除了 techwing/aixtron、NFI）。如果你现在以 ~$3.5B 的价格关注 $AEHR，他们就会走这样的路： - <$500m：“哦，他们没有客户！” ---> （可能在中间的某个地方）。 - < $1.5B：“也许销量很快就会到来！” - $3B+ 起：“看起来他们开始增加销量。这只是我个人经历中对阻塞点机器供应商周期的一个教训。

analysis.investment: 暂无针对此推文的具体建议。
